visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large, rectangular block of glossy, deep black grass jelly is placed on a light-colored wooden cutting board. A person wearing clear plastic gloves uses a specialized metal grater to scrape thin, noodle-like strands from the jelly's surface. The setting is a clean, bright industrial kitchen with stainless steel counters. (2) The shredded grass jelly is scooped into a clear plastic cup that features a black and white circular logo. The camera captures the texture of the jelly strands as they are poured from a metal pot. A finished drink, layered with white milk and dark jelly, is held up against a blurred store background. (3) A hand places a fresh block of jelly into a container. Milk and tea are poured into a cup, creating a marble-like swirl with the jelly strands. Close-up shots emphasize the delicate movement of the jelly pieces within the liquid. (4) The scene shifts to preparing a yellowish tea. Small cubes of green jelly and shaved ice are added to a cup. The cup is then turned upside down, showing the internal ingredients. (5) Pink fruit pulp is poured into a clear cup, followed by a stream of light brown oolong tea. A macro shot shows the vibrant pink fruit pieces and seeds mixed with the tea. (6) A ladle scoops a thick, dark purple mixture of red beans and purple rice from a large metal pot into a cup. White milk is added, creating a distinct white and purple layered effect. (7) Two paper cups with the brand logo are held outdoors against a background of green trees and soft daylight. A person at a counter hands over a white plastic bag containing multiple drinks. The final screen displays store information and a promotional poster for peach oolong tea.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, metallic scraping sound triggers the audio sequence as the narrator begins speaking with a high-energy, friendly tone. The background music is an upbeat acoustic guitar track with a moderate tempo. (2) A wet, squelching sound follows as jelly is scooped into a cup. The narrator's speech is fast-paced and enthusiastic. (3) A distinct liquid splash sound marks the pouring of milk into the cup, accompanied by the steady rhythmic strumming of the guitar. (4) The audio transitions with a faint digital whoosh. Rattling ice and liquid sloshing sounds are heard as a tea drink is prepared. (5) A thick, viscous splashing sound occurs as fruit pulp is added to the drink. The vocal delivery remains clear and well-articulated. (6) A metallic clink and a heavy thudding sound indicate the scooping of red beans. (7) A crinkling plastic bag rustle is audible as the transaction is completed. The video ends with a final promotional sentence from the narrator over a slight fade in the music.
